concerns.text: FR-002 specifies ANCOVA with age and education as covariates, yet the reporting requirements (FR-002 & FR-003) call for Cohen's d effect sizes with 95 % confidence intervals. Cohen's d is a raw, unadjusted standardized mean difference appropriate for simple t‑tests, not for ANCOVA-adjusted group comparisons. Using an unadjusted d after covariate adjustment creates a mismatch between the statistical model and the effect‑size metric, potentially misrepresenting the magnitude of group differences.
